segments.title: December
segments.text: Hello Kenkere House! December is Wrapped. The year is ending, everyone is reflecting, and every member has a story told in classes, favourite trainers and peak hours. This month we show them that story, and help them write next year's.

segments.title: ₹8.3L
segments.text: So, the number. Our December target for Kenkere House is 8.3 lakh rupees. That's 57 per cent up on last December. A stretch, but a friendly one.

segments.title: 4 streams
segments.text: Where does it come from? Renewals lead the way with 4.4 lakh rupees. That's 5 of every 10 rupees. Then new clients 2.82 lakh, everything else 58,100, and comebacks 49,800. Our existing members carry this month, so every renewal conversation matters.

segments.title: 42 buyers
segments.text: Behind the number are people: 625 leads, 225 trials, and 42 buyers, with about 19 per cent of trials converting. The trial class is where this month is won. Warm welcome, clear next step, every time.
Here's where the offers come in. Five offers carry 6.01 lakh rupees, which is 72 per cent of our target. The rest is full-price. Offers open the door. Great classes keep it open. Let's meet them.

segments.title: Resolution Pre-Order (Ships 1 Jan)
segments.text: First up, the Resolution Pre-Order. Ships first of January. Buy now, start between the first and tenth of January, and a coach checks in during week one so it actually sticks. That's 4 buyers, for 49,600 rupees.

segments.title: Secret Santa Squats
segments.text: Next, for gifting, Secret Santa Squats. Two classes and grip socks, sized for a Secret Santa budget. That's 9 buyers, for 13,500 rupees.

segments.title: Last Seen: 2026 (We Noticed)
segments.text: Then, for long-lapsed members, Last Seen, 2026. We noticed. Fifteen per cent off, a free comeback class, and a spot on the Stronger in 30 comeback track, before the new year. That's 4 buyers, for 49,600 rupees.

segments.title: Wrapped: Your Top Artist Was Your Trainer
segments.text: Also this month, Wrapped. Your top artist was your trainer. Every member gets their year in classes, trainers and peak hours, and next year's plan, priced for how they actually train. That's 8 buyers, for 3.2 lakh rupees.

segments.title: 12 Days of Shakemas
segments.text: And finally, the finale, Twelve Days of Shakemas. A new published deal every day from the thirteenth to the twenty-fourth. That's 8 buyers, for 1.68 lakh rupees.
segments.notes: One deal per person per day

segments.title: 4 weeks
segments.text: How does the month run? Week one, Wrapped cards go out to every member. Week two, twelve days of Shakemas begin on the thirteenth. Week three, gift vouchers and resolution pre-orders for the I'll start in January crowd. Week four, last-seen members get their invitation home.

segments.title: That's the plan
segments.text: That's December at Kenkere House. 8.3 lakh rupees, five offers, and 42 buyers to welcome. That's a wrap on 2027. See you on the mat in January.
